title: Siemens SIMATIC
summary: SIMATIC is Siemens' automation family. Current controllers are the S7-1200 (compact) and S7-1500 (modular), with ET 200SP distributed I/O, all engineered in TIA Portal. S7-300/400 are the previous generation.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body:
| Family | Role |
| --- | --- |
| S7-1200 | Compact controller for small machines, side-mounted signal modules |
| S7-1500 | Modular controller for medium to large machines and lines |
| ET 200SP | Fine-granular distributed I/O, usually on PROFINET |
| S7-300 / S7-400 | Previous generation, still widespread in existing plants |

sections.heading: Engineering
sections.body: Projects are created in **TIA Portal** (STEP 7 for programming, WinCC for HMI). Languages include LAD, FBD, SCL (Structured Text), STL (S7-300/400/1500) and GRAPH. Hardware is configured in the device view: rack, slots, start addresses and channel parameters.

sections.heading: Conventions worth knowing
sections.body:
- Process image addresses in byte.bit form: `%I0.0`, `%Q0.0`, analog words such as `%IW64`.
- Analog values use a nominal range of 0 to 27648 (bipolar -27648 to 27648) independent of the module resolution.
- Communication: PROFINET is the native fieldbus; PROFIBUS DP on older systems.
